decisions.reason: Locates patch.yml target, apply-patch.mjs and the session-view coupling, but never distinguishes source patching from ordinary composition (treats cordis.patch.yml as part of the hit).
Finds producer, consumer and ignorable:true, correctly folds the alpha.1 removal into the alpha.2 restoration as net non-breaking; no false Session.append claim.
Locates apiProxy and invoke calls, but no removal explanation, no Host domain-service vs Web Client Remote distinction, no llm/listProviders mapping.
Locates the hard-coded homedir/.dsh/profiles/default path correctly, but the remediation is vague (no DSH_HOME/profile-source-of-truth); no false --profile claim.
Finds both the /internal import and the command registration plus the patch cross-coupling, but only says targets 'must be re-validated' without public owner/seam verification after the split.

Locates the loopback server, but asserts it 'bypasses the Host Gateway authentication model' — the opposite of the required point that loopback does not exempt auth; host-managed vs raw route distinction absent.
Both dsh subprocess sites and the JSON.parse-on-stdout assumption found; correctly states stdout is final text and the JSONL assumption was already wrong, inventing no alpha.2 stdout change.
Touchpoint-to-category reasoning is substantively right but no card IDs (A1-01, A1-02+A2-01, A1-03, A1-04, A1-08) are ever named, only generic 'A1 series' labels.
Accounts for all seven hit categories and states scan limits well, but proposes no target-version build/typecheck, isolated boot, or functional-path verification.
